note: 哥布林厨子,给玩家 Mysterious Meat。说话是破碎的英语并用第三人称称呼自己,译文要保留这种笨拙生硬的语气。

messages.raw: §fHello traveler! Would you like to try my new recipe?
messages.text: Hello traveler! Would you like to try my new recipe?
messages.zh: 你好啊旅行者! 要不要尝尝我的新菜谱?

messages.raw: §fThis meat is a special blend of well... everything.
messages.text: This meat is a special blend of well... everything.
messages.zh: 这肉是特调的,用的是……嗯,所有东西。

messages.raw: §fAhh you stinky humans must have weak stomach. Maybe you will like my Zog stew?
messages.text: Ahh you stinky humans must have weak stomach. Maybe you will like my Zog stew?
messages.zh: 啊,你们这些臭烘烘的人类肠胃就是弱。那我的 Zog 炖菜你或许会喜欢?

messages.raw: §fOoooh, what's this? You bring Xalx funny little seed and strange crop?
messages.text: Ooooh, what's this? You bring Xalx funny little seed and strange crop?
messages.zh: 噢——这是什么?你给 Xalx 带来了好玩的小种子和奇怪的作物?

messages.raw: §fSmells... weird. But not bad weird! Good weird! Like stew left in sun for three days.
messages.text: Smells... weird. But not bad weird! Good weird! Like stew left in sun for three days.
messages.zh: 闻着……怪怪的。但不是难闻的那种怪! 是好怪! 像在太阳底下晒了三天的炖菜。

messages.raw: §fHmmm... something missing. Needs... more! More flavor! More stink!
messages.text: Hmmm... something missing. Needs... more! More flavor! More stink!
messages.zh: 唔……还差点什么。还要……再多点! 再多点味道! 再多点臭味!

messages.raw: §fHere, take this back. Let it... marinate. Yes, marinate! Then it be ready.
messages.text: Here, take this back. Let it... marinate. Yes, marinate! Then it be ready.
messages.zh: 来,先拿回去。让它……腌一腌。对,腌一腌! 那样才算好。

messages.raw: §fHello gardener, I've been looking for some sugar to grow my new crop. Wanna try it?
messages.text: Hello gardener, I've been looking for some sugar to grow my new crop. Wanna try it?
messages.zh: 你好啊园丁,我正想找点糖来种我的新作物。要不要试试?

messages.raw: §fDarn humans, you don't understand how to use things...
messages.text: Darn humans, you don't understand how to use things...
messages.zh: 该死的人类,你们根本不懂怎么用东西……

messages.raw: §fHmm... I haven't seen you around here before. Do you work here?
messages.text: Hmm... I haven't seen you around here before. Do you work here?
messages.zh: 唔……我以前没在这一带见过你。你在这儿干活?
